description.text: Surge by Peak XV backs founders from day zero with up to $5M in seed capital, dedicated investment partners and hands-on support, and a world-class company building programme.

targetApplicants.text: Surge also teaches you company building with empathy and care which as founders you will realise is largely missing from Investor community. If I were to build a new company, I would still start with Surge.
